messages.subject: Re: How to fix the values of mean/ intercept/ threshold in the multiple group analysis
parts:
If your factor is f, then
f ~ c(0, -0.5)*1
would work, if f is not a dependent variable. If f is dependent, then the parameter is only f's intercept, not its mean. But you could work out the equation for the mean of the factor, apply labels to model parameters, then create a constraint using those labeled parameter values.

On Thu, May 9, 2019 at 12:21 PM Chia-Wen Chen <fiv...@gmail.com> wrote:
I would like to fix the means of the latent trait to 0 for one group and to -0.5 for another group. 
I wrote the syntax as: 

Theta ~ c(0, -0.5)

where Theta is a latent trait.
However, this syntax is ineligible for lavaan.
How can I fix the two group means in lavaan syntax?

Thank you
Best Regards

Chia-Wen
